quote: If the driver of a vehicle intends to turn at an intersection and: Both intersecting highways are two-directional: The approach for a left turn must be made in that portion of the right half of the highway nearest the centerline thereof.

activation.condition: Driver intends to turn left at an intersection of two two-directional highways.

obligation.description: Approach for the left turn in the portion of the right half of the highway nearest its centerline.

timing.description: Observe original pre-entry approach, rather than departure-only or a single selected frame.

judgment_calls_needed.note: Both highway status and permitted opposing directions require independently sourced map and access review.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: portion of the right half of the highway nearest the centerline
judgment_calls_needed.note: The statute supplies no numeric lateral cutoff; full body history, lane width and geometry need review.

parameter_refs.name: approach_lateral_position
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: two planned offsets, 1.7 m and 2.7 m, as construction targets rather than legal thresholds
